scope: Synthetic out-of-model stress test. Exact default 30 s / 50 m temporal-cell matching, no tolerance; truth uses counterfactual device event contribution >=8 bpm in at least half the window readings for >=60% of the four devices. False positives here mean flags without this constructed physical contribution, not false detections of any measured change. Legacy eligible_fraction_among_reported excludes absent windows. The coverage object instead uses the supplied counterfactual observation domain, with eligibility, silent windows, and unconditional/eligible-only event recall kept separate; this denominator is unavailable from received packets alone. No parameter tuning, hardware/clinical validation, or assertion of independent scientific review.
